name: Goals & activity feed
summary: For long-running agents, the main interface is a list of goals or tasks plus a feed of what the agent has done, is doing and proposes next. Users check in asynchronously, approve or redirect work, and read progress instead of chatting turn by turn.
how: Let the user set goals or tasks for the agent
Log each step, result and status change to a feed
Surface proposals and questions that need approval
Notify the user on other channels when something needs attention
facts: Slack agent session status; Teams agent sessions
Fits background work, but adds state and notification design
goodFor: Agents that run for hours or days
Reviewing many agent actions at a glance
watchOut: Needs a clear approval flow for risky actions
